map.🧭 为什么用中位数而不是均值: 🧭 Why use the median instead of the mean
map.对 1, 2, 3, 4, 100 这组数据，均值 = 110/5 = 22，中: For the data 1, 2, 3, 4, 100 the mean is 110/5 = 22 while the median is 3. A single extreme value lifts the mean more than 7×, whereas the median only sits in the middle. Long-tailed distributions such as income, house prices and response times are therefore better described by the median; but the median does not take part in summation, so it cannot be used to allocate a total.
map.不排序直接取中间：输入顺序不代表大小顺序，必须先升序。 偶数个忘记平均：n=4: Taking the middle without sorting: input order is not size order, so ascending sort is required. Forgetting to average with an even count: for n=4 the median is the mean of the 2nd and 3rd values, not either one. Treating the median as the mean: the median does not satisfy "the deviations from the centre sum to 0" and cannot be used to split a budget.
